title: Literal indices below the variable bound
statement: Let $\varphi$ be a CNF formula with natural-number variable indices, let $C$ be a clause in $\varphi$, and let $\ell$ be a literal in $C$. Then the variable index of $\ell$ is strictly less than the variable count of $\varphi$.
hypotheses_covered: $\varphi$ is a CNF formula with natural-number variable indices
replaced:
Let $\varphi$ be a CNF formula, $C$ a clause of $\varphi$, and $\ell$ a literal of
$C$. Then the variable index of $\ell$ is strictly below the variable bound of
$\varphi$ (the maximum over all occurring indices $v$ of $v + 1$).
